title: Tuning request (triage to detection engineering)
description: A tuning request from triage to detection engineering: the detection, the evidence with verdicts on both axes, the proposed change and its tests, governance for exceptions, and the resolution.

requestType.description: Request type (one): exception · enrichment · logic change · data or pipeline fix · severity change · new detection · risk-rule request · documentation · vendor case or wrapper rule · retire

routedTo.description: Routed to (rule owner, pipeline owner, vendor contact, or pattern-library owner)

materialAiUse.description: Material AI use (assistant and version, and which fields began as AI drafts; "none" if unassisted)

ruleNameIdAnd.x-assured-prompt: Rule name, ID, and version as deployed when it fired
ruleNameIdAnd.description: Rule name, ID, and version as deployed when it fired (for a new-detection request: "none fired", and the technique that went unseen)

provider.description: Provider (in-house · vendor-managed · community Sigma · managed provider) and whether the logic is inspectable (yes · no: vendor-managed)

attAndCkTechnique.description: ATT&CK technique ID(s) and version (e.g. Enterprise v19), and the Detection Strategy (DET) and Analytic (AN) IDs where known

exceptionsSuppressionsAndPattern.x-assured-prompt: Exceptions, suppressions, and pattern entries active on this rule when it fired
exceptionsSuppressionsAndPattern.description: Exceptions, suppressions, and pattern entries active on this rule when it fired (IDs)

cases.description: Cases (every case ID that motivated the request)

sampleAlertIds.description: Sample alert IDs (benign samples for exceptions and fixes; for a gap, the event IDs of the activity that raised no alert)

verdictOnBothAxes.x-assured-prompt: Verdict on both axes, using the exact values

detection.description: Detection: true positive · false positive (logic) · false positive (data)

activity.description: Activity: malicious · policy violation · authorized (benign true positive) · benign-confirmed · undetermined

verdictOnBothAxes.description: Verdict on both axes, using the exact values

windowAndVolume.description: Window and volume (fires in the window, and how many carried each verdict)

observedPrecision.description: Observed precision (true-positive fires / fires with a detection verdict, benign true positives counted as correct) and actionability (fires that needed action beyond the close / fires), with the window

theFieldsAndValues.x-assured-prompt: The fields and values that justify the change
theFieldsAndValues.description: The fields and values that justify the change

whatTheAnalystCould.x-assured-prompt: What the analyst could not see
whatTheAnalystCould.description: What the analyst could not see (missing fields, telemetry the rule does not read)

theChangeAsSpecifically.x-assured-prompt: The change, as specifically as you can state it
theChangeAsSpecifically.description: The change, as specifically as you can state it. For an exception, the tuple it is keyed to (for a tool: version or pinned hash, extension or plugin ID, destination set). Never signer and install path alone.

scope.description: Scope (entity- or field-level; anything rule-wide needs the approver's explicit sign-off)

expectedEffect.description: Expected effect (volume, precision and actionability before and after)

riskOfTheChange.description: Risk of the change (what it could silence, and how an attacker could ride it)

benignSampleThatShould.x-assured-prompt: Benign sample that should stop alerting, or should now carry the new field
benignSampleThatShould.description: Benign sample that should stop alerting, or should now carry the new field

maliciousSampleOrEmulation.x-assured-prompt: Malicious sample or emulation that must still fire
maliciousSampleOrEmulation.description: Malicious sample or emulation that must still fire (event replay, or an Atomic Red Team test ID for the technique)

approver.description: A second person, not the author or requester.

expiryDate.description: Expiry date (by default 90 days; shorter for a tool that updates often)

reFireTriggers.description: Re-fire triggers (e.g. version change, new extension or plugin ID, destination outside the set, rule change, observed abuse)

hitCountMonitoring.description: Hit-count monitoring (expected hits per week, and the threshold that forces review)

linkedPatternEntry.description: Linked pattern entry (PTN-NNN and version), if one exists

reTestAtExpiry.description: Re-test at expiry: the malicious sample from section 5 still fires.

decision.description: Decision (accepted · accepted with changes · declined), with the reason

changeReference.description: Change reference (pull request or commit) and deployed rule version

testsRunAndResults.description: Tests run, and results (benign sample, malicious sample)

patternEntriesInvalidatedBy.x-assured-prompt: Pattern entries invalidated by this change, and their owners notified
patternEntriesInvalidatedBy.description: Pattern entries invalidated by this change, and their owners notified

resultAfter30Days.description: Result after 30 days (volume, precision, any reversed closes or missed detections)
